categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in turnkey engineering services integrating cleanroom and mechanical-electrical-air conditioning (MEP) systems primarily for high-tech industries such as semiconductors, printed circuit boards (PCB), optoelectronics, and data centers. It also serves commercial office buildings and industrial plants with MEP engineering and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include cleanroom design and construction, MEP system integration, HVAC engineering, electrical power distribution, fire safety systems, process piping, and automation control systems. The company employs 3D modeling and BIM software for intelligent project management and customized design, enhancing quality, efficiency, and cost control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor fabs, PCB manufacturers, optoelectronics firms, and data center operators primarily in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia. The company supports industries requiring high-purity manufacturing environments and complex MEP infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, Greater China, and Southeast Asia, with subsidiaries established in Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, and China to support regional projects and international expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the supply chain as an engineering contractor providing integrated design, procurement, construction, and commissioning services, coordinating with upstream equipment and material suppliers and downstream end-users in high-tech manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core competencies in cleanroom and MEP turnkey solutions, expanding into diversified industries and geographic markets, and advancing intelligent control engineering through 3D modeling and BIM integration. The company emphasizes sustainable development, energy efficiency, and ESG compliance in R&D and operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based turnkey engineering contracts involving design, procurement, construction, and system integration services. Income is recognized progressively as projects are completed and delivered.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other domestic and international MEP and cleanroom engineering firms such as Han Tang Integration, Sheng Hui Engineering, and Ya Xiang Engineering. It leverages long-standing industry experience, technical expertise, and strong client relationships to maintain a competitive position in the high-tech turnkey engineering market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$15.19 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a slight decrease of 2.07% from the prior year but improved gross margin and net profit growth of around 12% and 15%, respectively. It maintains a healthy financial structure with increasing assets and equity, and positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by providing highly customized, integrated cleanroom and MEP turnkey solutions tailored to the stringent requirements of high-tech manufacturing environments. Its use of advanced 3D modeling and intelligent control technologies enhances project quality and efficiency, while its strong project management capabilities and sustainable practices add value to clients.
